content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: the top-level Hedging control gives no visible response to a click, so users click it again and then move to the Tools menu, which reaches Hedge Relationship (Hedging clicks at 15 and 47/53 and at 16 and 42/48 are followed by focus on Tools at 20 and 21, and the menu route ends in Hedge Relationship at 62 and 57 with the overlay and navigation to hedge relationship:screen following).", "fix": "Fix: On the Hedging trigger (the span inside the top-level button labelled \"Hedging\" on the hedge relationship screen's header), either open the Hedge Relationship menu on click with a visible open state (for example set aria-expanded and render the menu items immediately), or remove the click target from this span if Tools > Hedge Relationship is the intended route.", "cited_event_ids": ["15", "47", "53", "20", "62", "16", "42", "48", "21", "57", "app:6"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["The events do not show whether a menu or any other element appears after each Hedging click, so the 'no visible state change' from detector D14 is not directly confirmed.", "The reason users switched to the Tools menu is not stated in the events.", "Pointer sampling was incomplete (28 and 137 dropped pointer samples), so hover or pointer behaviour around the Hedging control cannot be fully checked.", "Only two sessions and two users are in the evidence; no coverage gaps were reported for the insight.", "The 1\u201310 s interval in the insight is taken from the facts; the windows show repeated Hedging clicks about 0.4\u20130.5 s apart within each session."]}
